openQuestions.question: The Work describes plays being run, things being assigned, and events being recorded — is the unit of work a play run, an assignment, or a ledger event? Which record actually carries the status?
Is the lifecycle marker on the unit of work actually named `status` in source, or something else?
Director assignment and ledger-fired triggers both appear to start work — is there one canonical entry point, or two parallel ones?
Is the coin a distinct place or just the rendering of the agent inside the visual interface?
